Name: Zerah, the Ethiopian
Summary: Zerah the Ethiopian came against Asa with an army of a thousand thousand and three hundred chariots, and was defeated at Mareshah when Asa cried to the LORD.
KeyStory: Asa prayed that it is nothing with the LORD to help with many or with few, and the LORD smote the Ethiopians before Asa.
LifeLesson: No multitude is too great for the LORD to help against, when His people rest on Him.
